author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Provides a bounded multi-platform play-with-viewers queue with source-routed commands, creator controls, and a read-only overlay.
changelog: 2.5.0: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.5.0 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.3: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.4.3 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.2: initial release with serialized queue state, four source-routed commands, creator-only controls, offline policy, and privacy-bounded overlay projection.

manifest.name: Viewer Lobby
installationSteps: Install Viewer Lobby and import its creator controls.
Configure commands, limits, privacy, and overlay fields.
Attach Open/Close/Pause/Resume/Next/Random/Clear only to creator-controlled triggers.
uninstallationSteps: Export any wanted queue summary before uninstalling. Private state remains preserved.

healthChecks.description: Confirms serialized source-routed queue commands and creator-only controls are available.
